text: The book stresses that length contraction L = L₀/γ is a direct consequence of which fact?
choices: A real physical compression of the moving rod by molecular forces
The rod's proper length L₀ changing with speed
Time dilation acting on the atoms inside the rod
The relativity of simultaneity — measuring both ends at the same time is frame-dependent
explanation: Measuring a length requires locating both ends simultaneously, and simultaneity is frame-dependent; this is why L = L₀/γ. The book emphasizes the rod is not physically compressed (choice 0 is the discarded aether-era interpretation) and its rest/proper length L₀ is unchanged (choice 1). Length contraction and time dilation are two aspects of one geometric fact.
